definitions: Cite or appeal to (someone or something) as an authority for an action or in support of an argument.
Call on (a deity or spirit) in prayer, as though by a spell.
Call forth a spirit or demon.
Cause (a procedure, law, or rule) to come into effect by citing it.
examples: The Prime Minister invoked the 1997 agreement.
She invoked the goddess of fertility.
He invoked a demon from the underworld.
The company invoked a rarely used clause.
